audit.method: Direct model translation followed by a complete source-target editorial reading of the first eight Sebastian Room records: Sebastian’s programming scene and follow-ups, Robin’s interruption, both conversation branches, and the complete Solarion character-selection setup. Every line, embedded question, response choice, conditional and gender branch, programming term, fantasy title and class, and character voice was reviewed in full event context with canonical Sebastian, Sam, Robin, Abigail and Maru terminology. Event commands, actors, movement, timing, friendship and prior-choice conditions, response IDs, placeholders, branch delimiters, emotion markers, music and sound IDs, and non-text payloads were preserved and structurally compared with English. The remaining tabletop-game branches are handled separately. The full-locale final audits remain pending.
